data_policy: Use committed isolated-worktree Qlib snapshots, not mutable live providers with different end dates. Source manifests, feature rows and labels are hashed and retained in Recorder.
user_objective: stable net excess versus SOXX; no claim of guaranteed future excess

architecture.reuse: DirectContinuousAllocationNet with8hiddenunits,actual3asset pretrade holdings,fee-funded cash settlement
architecture.output: continuous softmax weights, long-only and fully cash-funded

training.refit: annual expanding; all train outcome-availability timestamps strictly before fit-year January1 NewYork
training.ensemble: equal mean of three target-weight predictions on the same actual current holdings; its own continuous cost-dependent path, never average portfolio returns or pick a seed
training.block_sampling: without replacement up to32chronological blocks per epoch; all blocks if fewer; stride63 plus final complete84session block
training.objective: For each chronological block, compute63-session own-portfolio logwealth growth minus SOXX logwealth growth after21warmup sessions; minimize negative mean relative growth plus root mean squared negative relative growth. Actual risky notional fees are inside every portfolio step. No added arbitrary trade-count penalty.
training.pit_auxiliary: Shared common-feature projection, regression of constituent5-day close-return and volatility; published PIT members only with conservative1session publication lag; no union backfill or short-history2x products; each marketdate has total sampleweight1. Before PIT history is available B equals A.
training.forecast_features: Annual out-of-fold Ridge(alpha10) predictions of cash_advantage_1d and future_vol_5d from16SOXX common features, using only matured prior-year labels. Minimum252mature rows; explicit availability indicator, neutral0for unavailable forecasts. A/B reserve the same two zero forecast fields and availability0.
training.checkpoint_selection: fixed final epoch; all seeds retained

evaluation.benchmark: 100percentSOXX,entryfee funded from cash, same sessions and prices
evaluation.cost_method: rerun each actual policy and seed/ensemble from its own holdings at each cost, not subtract costs from a frozen trade path
development_gate: paired-logexcess stationarybootstrap lowerbound positive with20and60session meanblocks

bootstrap.interpretation: Bonferroni adjustment for three preregistered variants; conditional historical evidence only, not correction for all prior research or a future guarantee

evaluation.native_verification: Qlib backtest/Exchange/Position next-open settlement reconciliation with actual schedule; US252annualization and initialNAV1 anchoreddrawdown
evaluation.selection: Choose only from full historical passers, highest minimum20/60block lowerbound across bothcosts; otherwise retain highest number of passed gates as diagnostic only. Seal selection before post2022 evaluation.
evaluation.static_risk_reference: SOXX/cash fixedmix0.25/0.5/0.75/1.0,reported only; do not choose fullsample volatility-matched weight and present it as deployable
evaluation.outer: 2023-2026 already viewed in earlier research; diagnostic only. Annual refits mature before each decision year; never change selected family based on these results.
evaluation.negative_result: Do not relax gates, choose the best seed, change horizon, add overlays, or continue an unregistered grid after observing failure. Retain all outcomes and identify evidence missing for stable excess.

deployment.new_forward: Frozen models and same-quote independent candidate/baseline paths are required before any stable-forward-excess claim; existing prior model forward days do not transfer to this model.
